scenario: A finance audit analyst must validate a close conclusion before manager review.
trigger_event: A manager requests an independent validation before close.

evidence_nodes.intended_contents: Transaction-level observations with stable evidence identifiers.
Independent totals and policy conditions used for validation.

required_judgments.description: Determine which evidence items reconcile and explain material mismatches.
Separate confirmed exceptions from gaps that need follow-up.

skill_bindings.observable_behavior: The candidate performs and records an independent cross-check.
The candidate classifies exceptions without inventing missing support.

deliverable_intent.business_use: Support a close review and direct follow-up on unresolved items.

productive_complexity: Connect independent evidence paths before concluding.
Preserve an unresolved exception requiring professional judgment.
accidental_difficulty_to_avoid: Avoid hidden join keys and ambiguous submission instructions.
deterministic_fact_constraints: All identifiers, amounts, policy clauses, and expected classifications must be materialized and verified by code.
assumptions_not_allowed: Do not assume balances, thresholds, policies, or facts absent from candidate-visible evidence.
